title: feat(w2k16): cost-2 out-face same-k holds at k=16: t=32 vs t=52
science: Strongest same-k result in the band: one Dijkstra on B_48 gives w2 t(16,0,0)=32 vs t(16,16,16)=52 (3072>2704) AND reports k=15 (31 vs 49), k=14 (30 vs 46) and k=1 (3 vs 5) all holding. Those four points pin the out-face axis law t=m+16 (30,31,32 at m=14,15,16) against the invariant body law 3k+4, from which the relocated wall at k=19 follows. t(48,0,0)=69, t(45,0,0)=61, t(3,2,0)=10.
